## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I used only invented, synthetic examples and fixtures.
- [ ] This change contains no adopter, customer, employer, partner, or private-project identifiers.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, payloads, configuration, and test data are not production-derived.
- [ ] I reviewed secrets, permissions, untrusted input, and workflow-injection risks.
- [ ] Executable third-party automation is pinned to an immutable revision.
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Release notes are included or the change does not require them.
